reviews.author: Vin Min
reviews.text: Our family was on a road trip from NYC to myrtle beach when a wheel bearing blew leaving our Tahoe disable in Goldsboro NC. It being a Saturday at 1 pm most mechanic shops were closed for the weekend leaving us very little options. Irayalis stayed open for us waiting for the car to be towed in, they ordered the parts and fixed the vehicle and we were back on the road in 4 hours from the time the car broke down till we pulled away. Remarkable service!!!! They saved our road trip and they were priced correctly. Many thanks!!! Highly Recommend!!!!

reviews.author: Latasha Adams
reviews.text: My mom lives in North Carolina and was having some car issues. She was very worried about having her car repaired by an honest mechanic. And with me being in another state, made it difficult for me to directly help her. But I was able to find this particular shop online and referred my mom there. Her experience was so wonderful! My mom was grateful to have Ms Irayalis patiently wait for her to arrive with the vehicle and admired on how Irayalis fixed her car with care. My mom enjoyed the quality of service provided by the mechanic and their prices are reasonable. My mom loves her new mechanic and couldn't be any more pleased. Thank you Irayalis Auto Service for help my mom with her vehicle and putting my mind at ease!

reviews.author: Denise Johnson
reviews.text: I went in to get a quote for an A/C compressor for my 99 Toyota Tacoma. While communicating with Irayalis, she made me feel comfortable with allowing her to service my vehicle. She was very professional and knowledgeable when answering my questions. She also communicated with ease about what was needed and how long it would take. The service was reasonably priced and once she finished my vehicle she was helpful in pointing out some suggested reairs. My AC runs great. I would highly recommend Irayalis Auto Shop for anyone looking for a mechanic who is who is honest, fair, knowledgeable, and professional.

reviews.author: Dariona
reviews.text: Irayalis is a very good mechanic! My car has had multiple issues and she has always been very helpful of making sure that those issues were resolved. She does her best to try to work with you money wise as well! if your car is going through something and no one seems to know what the issue is, take it to her! you won’t regret it.

reviews.author: Trish McMahon
reviews.text: Ira is awesome, her number one goal is customer satisfaction. I purchased a set used tires for my Durango. I couldn't have been happier. Not only did she have a set of great used set, but she had a matching full-sized spare! Her customer service skills are excellent. She pointed out where the problem was with my control arm bushings. This had caused the problem with previous tire wearing prematurely. She suggested immediate replacement, seeing how almost none of the bushing was left, I agreed. She also recommended front brakes soon. She was very thorough with the job and the bill was as nice as the customer service. It did not break the bank. It felt so good to be riding on smooth riding good tires and still have money in the bank! Thanks Ira!

reviews.author: Amber Grate
reviews.text: I just moved here from Florida 2 months ago and after a few days my car started leaking oil. I didn’t understand why because a Jiffy Lube down in Florida had just did my oil change and replaced my oil sensor that they said needed to be replaced and was why my check engine light was on. The part wasn’t properly placed and slowly my car was leaking oil and I didn’t even know it after driving over 700 miles. When I arrived to NC I went to Jiffy lube and was told they were unable to fix it. After research I finally found this place and went solely based upon previous reviews. Best decision ever. Most of these big chain places are all about over charging and doing work that really doesn’t need to be done. Irayalis was honest from the start and they took their time fixing my car making sure the problem was fixed. My car was leaking in several different places. She has earned a lifetime customer. No more big chains that charge you thousands and can’t even get the job done right. Thank you so much! My dad will be bringing in his two cars that need work done as well.

reviews.author: Antonia H
reviews.text: Irayalis is very professional, skilled, knowledgeable and courteous when speaking with customers about their vehicles. She has repaired my BMW 328 i in a very timely manner and it was affordable and now running great. From day one she quoted the prices prior to repairs with no hidden cost, very honest. She also repaired my daughter's Dodge Stratus at a very reasonable price. She also repair and perform routine maintenance for Mercedes which is very difficult to find a mechanic shop in our area who work on foreign vehicles. I highly recommend her shop to all.

reviews.author: Logan 'MURKA
reviews.text: Rude, arrogant, and insulting. The owner treated me like i was stupid. I know more about cars than she ever will. On top of being an engineer, and replacing motors, trannys, and loads of front end parts on my own cars. She tried to play a guessing game to repair my car to the tune of $1,000 (for one bad coil) and then got mad when i called her out and called me stupid. Then she tried to charge me for “diagnosing” what the problem was, even thought i told her what the problem was when i dropped it off

reviews.author: donia baldwin-akamu
reviews.text: My son's car needed a wheel barrier, axle, hub, and spindle cause it went out. Irayalis was able to get us in and complete the job in a timely manner. She also noticed he needed a tire rod end and was able to replace that as well. Pricing is very reasonable. I'd recommend this shop to anyone. We will definitely be returning here again when services are needed. Thank you Irayalis!

reviews.author: Nia
reviews.text: I could never have imagined having such a positive experience with a MECHANIC! Ira is so honest, professional, and personable! She went far above any expectations I could have ever had for a car repair. My 13 year old car runs better than it did when I got it! She gave me every accommodation you could imagine to make a lengthy and complicated repair as smooth as possible for me. God forbid I ever have to go anywhere else for repair or maintenance because Irayalis has my standards set high! Wish I could rate her 10 stars!

reviews.author: Tyanna Latham
reviews.text: I receive wonderful customer service from Irayalis. She showed great hospitality and was very professional. I don't know much about cars however, Irayalis was able to explain and show me what was wrong with my car. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: LaVonda Lee
reviews.text: I would recommend Irayalis to anyone in need of any car services. She always gets the job done, no questions asked. She does a great job, & also has reasonable prices. Thanks Ira for always coming through for me.

reviews.author: David Rodgers
reviews.text: She is awesome!! Been to the shop twice, the first time she met me at the shop on a Saturday to do a tire before I headed out of town. Yesterday I showed up to her shop 10 minutes before closing & she again with no rush made sure she took care of me before she left. Good Customer Service Good Prices Good Work

reviews.author: Sharon Price
reviews.text: Irayalis' is simply awesome! FAST, dependable, professional work... done right! I have three automobiles, 2004 Ford Ranger truck, 1997 Honda Accord and 2004 Ford Taurus. She keeps my old vehicles on the road and will always be my "go to" auto repair service!

reviews.author: Ebb
reviews.text: Ida is the TRUTH! I got my car towed to the shop Friday when it broke trying to got put gas in it. She had it diagnosed and fixed by Tuesday! Her customer service is amazing! I will be continue to consult with Ida on my car and take it her when it's necessary. Thank you so much again!!

reviews.author: nicole b
reviews.text: I had my brakes done here. I told her what all I wanted done, she let me know what was needed so that I wouldn’t pay for something that wasn’t. Thank you so much for great customer service!! She was friendly, honest, ,knowledgeable and fast.

reviews.author: M Lew
reviews.text: Irayalis figured out the problem with my vehicle in a short period of time. I was pleased with level of knowledge and professionalism. In fact, I have already scheduled another appointment with Irayalis to have additional repairs to my vehicle. Thank you!

reviews.author: shay exum
reviews.text: Very professional and friendly! Went in for a set of new tires and she had me out and rolling in a very timely manner. Will definitely return here for business! Very reasonable prices as well which is also a HUGE plus!

reviews.author: Carrigan Chastain
reviews.text: Great customer serivce! My starter went out on a Saturday and before the owner was even open for business I had scheduled a service that would get me back on the road within a couple hours! Fair price, dependable work, and pleasant, clear communications.

reviews.author: Dorothy Foreman
reviews.text: This is a great garage would highly recommend it. We were down visiting my daughter.we are from PA and the clutch went out of our car. Irayalis stayed open and continued working on it on Easter Day so we could get back to PA in time. Thank you

reviews.author: Adrian Lee
reviews.text: Best shop in Goldsboro. I've brung all my vehicles here for inspections. She also has worked on my Durango twice for different repairs. Gets the job done in a timely manner. No complaints. I do recommend this shop

reviews.author: Angela Hamm
reviews.text: The service that Irayalis is amazing. She completely goes out of her way to make sure your car is properly fixed.It's good to have mechanic who cares.

reviews.author: Leslie Mackenzie
reviews.text: We had a broken axel and our truck was way out of alignment. Irayalis fixed us right up and did the work in a timely fashion. We will definitely use her again.

reviews.author: Empath Naga
reviews.text: Haven't had a bad experience yet. Great prices, comfortable waiting area, and Irayalis herself is great and super friendly. Gets the job done quick every time.

reviews.author: Carla King
reviews.text: Purchased a vehicle, saw a leak, and took it to this auto service to get it fixed. I was given specific time frames and amounts. The charges increased from 300 to over 600 while my car sat from Feb 3rd onto as of today and continues to sit causing more issues. Overall, the engine, the most severe issue, was caused due to negligent, incorrect, and incomplete services trying to fix a simple leak. We all make mistakes...fix it.

reviews.author: Cherree' Ruffin
reviews.text: Great customer service. Ira explained everything before she did anything, and she has very reasonable prices. I definitely recommend her!

reviews.author: Denise Stephens
reviews.text: Very good customer service...I definitely will be returning if I have any car troubles. I highly recommend this shop to anyone. Check her out if you have car repair needs.

reviews.author: Mary Semela
reviews.text: I will always choose to have my repairs done at this shop. Service was excellent, and I have a lot of confidence in the quality of the work. I would recommend this shop to any and all. I felt like my patronage was valued and the job was done with care.

reviews.author: Lashiya Rowe
reviews.text: I really feel at home coming here. I save so much money coming to see my girl Ira. She will make sure your car is done right and if anything is wrong she will fix it with no problem. Go see her when you have any car issues etc

reviews.author: lisa ortiz
reviews.text: This auto shop does exceptional work and in a timely matter ! If you’re in need of a great mechanic this is the place to go ! She will keep you informed through the whole process , no matter how big or small the job !

reviews.author: Pineapple Brown
reviews.text: Scam artists will break your vehicle. Over charges ppl. Tried to tell me that I had an oil leak. Took it to 2 other mechanics and didn't have an oil leak. That lady is a scammer

reviews.author: Valorie Gregory
reviews.text: Ira and her team demonstrate great customer service and great work. They are economical and are capable of handling a variety of types of vehicles!

reviews.author: Kyle Miltier
reviews.text: I would highly recommend Irayalis. She does good honest work at a price more competitive than most. She also must be one of the most friendly mechanics in the Goldsboro area.

reviews.author: Jamie Hansson
reviews.text: Ira will treat you like family. She's very thorough with everything she does. I will ALWAYS bring my vehicles here. I would recommend this place to everybody!

reviews.author: Jeana Smith
reviews.text: I recommend whom ever need a mechanic go check out Ms IRA she's the best she worked on my daughter bmw did fantastic work magnificent work she's awesome very humble very respectful very polite & honest I will always go to her me and my familygo check her out the great thing about her she's very very affordable!!!! Love her!

reviews.author: Cooper Xavier
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing service. I came to Irayalis with engine problems, within a day she fixed it and had it back on the road. Couldnt ask for better service.

reviews.author: Erica Burton
reviews.text: The owner is very honest which is hard to find in this business. All I can say is wonderful The service was done so fast and a a great deal compared to other places in the area. The work is excellent!!! Will be a lifetime customer!

reviews.author: Jill Purnell
reviews.text: She is very nice and knows her job.She has always made me feel welcome and comfortable And I know she is not going to take advantage of me because of my gender..

reviews.author: Jason Williams
reviews.text: I've been coming here a couple years now. Always explain service and reasonable rates. I will continue to bring my vehicle. I highly recommend Irayalis.

reviews.author: Rodney Wren Jr
reviews.text: I love the customer experience I get when I go here. Very thorough and they explained everything to where I understood what & why they were doing it! Work trucks & personal trucks! My new mechanic!!!

reviews.author: Maria Cristina
reviews.text: Was having issues with our car and thought the axel needed fixing but they were able to tell me the issue was and fixed it with a reasonable price. Great customer service too!!

reviews.author: Corneshia Lamb
reviews.text: Irayalis is my go to mechanic. Great customer service ! Great prices ! This shop always get the job done right and in a timely manner!

reviews.author: Shands McCoy
reviews.text: The service was great. Every step was explained before & after the repairs were completed. Affordable prices. Pleasant personality. I will be going back. Shands McCoy

reviews.author: alberta perry
reviews.text: Service was amazing. They assessed my car and fixed it with no problems. People are friendly and quality service.

reviews.author: Sara Renee
reviews.text: She was great frienly she found the problem and as soon as we drove off the lot it was driving didn't even cut off I would diffently go back to her for more work ons on my car. Thanks.

reviews.author: Toya Croom
reviews.text: They were very professional. And the prices were affordable. I'll definitely recommend Irayalis to anyone with auto needs.

reviews.author: Stephanie Litaker
reviews.text: They are open after 5 which is good for people that get off work at 5. I really needed a tire and everywhere was closed. Very nice people
